# Kitchener Furnace Repair

> From its base in Kitchener, Waterloo Region, Kitchener Furnace Repair serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 918-0574  |  Email: contact@kitchenerfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://kitchenerfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: Kitchener, Cambridge, Waterloo, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
